senses.sense_definition: A two-colour fabric pattern consisting of broken or jagged checks.

examples.text: The designer chose a classic black and white <w>houndstooth</w> for the winter coat collection.

target_lang_translations.zh: 设计师为冬季外套系列选用了经典的黑白<w>千鸟格</w>。

examples.text: Sophisticated <w>houndstooth</w> checks highlight the toddler's jacket and hat.

target_lang_translations.zh: 精致的<w>千鸟格</w>纹样点缀着幼儿的夹克和帽子。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 一种由破碎或锯齿状方格组成的双色织物图案。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指代这种经典的黑白交错织物图案。

senses.sense_definition: An item of clothing made from fabric featuring a houndstooth pattern.

examples.text: She wore a vintage wool <w>houndstooth</w> that belonged to her mother.

target_lang_translations.zh: 她穿了一件属于她母亲的复古羊毛<w>千鸟格外套</w>。

examples.text: The stylish jacket was a bold <w>houndstooth</w> that stood out in the crowd.

target_lang_translations.zh: 这件时髦的夹克是醒目的<w>千鸟格</w>款式，在人群中非常显眼。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 用千鸟格面料制成的服装。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指代使用千鸟格纹样的具体衣物。

senses.sense_definition: A plant of the species Cynoglossum officinale, also known as hound's tongue.

examples.text: The botanist identified the <w>houndstooth</w> growing along the edge of the forest path.

target_lang_translations.zh: 植物学家辨认出长在林间小路边缘的<w>倒提壶</w>。

examples.text: While hiking, we spotted a rare <w>houndstooth</w> blooming in the meadow.

target_lang_translations.zh: 徒步时，我们发现草地上开着一株稀有的<w>倒提壶</w>。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 一种名为倒提壶的植物，学名为Cynoglossum officinale。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指代紫草科倒提壶属植物。
